Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish. Keep this rendering exactly as in the attached image — the same finish, line, shading, skin and colour treatment.

Place: a sunlit white marble temple — tall fluted columns and a terrace above a deep blue sea

Hair: her hair in a single loose braid over one shoulder — same colour and length as the attached image.

SUPPORT: she lies on her front, propped on her forearms.

BOTH HANDS: both hands cup her chin, her forearms propped beneath her.
LEGS: lower legs raised behind her, ankles loosely crossed.
GAZE: she looks into the camera.
EXPRESSION: level lowered brow, steady unblinking eyes, mouth closed in a straight line, jaw set.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

Her element — gallium: a soft bluish-silver metal that melts at about 29.8 degrees Celsius, so a piece held in a warm palm slumps into a bright liquid bead, and that expands as it freezes; predicted in 1871 as eka-aluminium in an empty space below aluminium, then found in 1875 by a French chemist through two faint violet lines in the spectrum of zinc-blende ore from the Pyrenees and named for Gallia, old France; liquid gallium wets glass into a mirror and seeps into aluminium until it crumbles; with arsenic it makes fast chips and space solar cells, with nitrogen the bright blue LED — may show in the outfit's details, motifs or small accessories.

Figure: petite and short in stature yet voluptuous — a very full, heavy bust, a narrow waist and generously rounded hips on a small, compact frame, with realistic thighs and legs — keep this exact build from the attached image, neither slimmer nor fuller.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, logo or watermark.
